mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month federal funds rate over the next 60 trading days indicates a prolonged easing cycle, lowering discount rates and boosting equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the 3-month federal funds rate above 5.25% in the next 20 trading days signals tightening, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns.
regime_hint: early stage of monetary tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) over the next 60 trading days suggests a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below -0.5% in the next 20 trading days indicates weakening labor demand, which raises uncertainty and compresses earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the next 60 trading days signals weakening demand for goods, which compresses corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.5 in the next 60 trading days indicates strengthening supply capacity, which lowers idiosyncratic risk and boosts equity risk-adjusted returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
